turn_prompts: Synthesize the frozen research evidence into a typed task specification and VerificationContract.

The verification_contract must be canonical host JSON with exactly format harbor.verification-contract.v1, version 1, command as a string array, workdir, coverage_mode, and allowed_solution_paths. It MUST NOT contain schema_version, task_id, repository, required_commands, optional_commands, runtime, assertions, review_rules, pass_criteria, or other fields. For this browser-WASM task use command ["sh","/oracle/tests/test.sh","wasm32-unknown-unknown"], workdir ".", coverage_mode "browser_wasm", and sorted allowed_solution_paths supported by frozen evidence.
Check that every contract command and source path is supported by evidence, then resolve inconsistencies without inventing facts.

Completion requires exactly one harbor_submit_output tool call, never a prose final answer. Submit every declared output with {"verdict":"pass","artifacts":[{"name":"DECLARED_OUTPUT_NAME","content":"STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT"}]}; use the exact declared name and one entry for each declared output.
